workflow: An owned isolated AutoCAD 24.3 scratch process plots ACI and TrueColor entities through Color, monochrome.ctb, Grayscale.ctb, Plot Lineweights OFF and 40% transparency profiles, then saves and reopens an anonymous native DWG without weakening SECURELOAD.
result: Native PDF operators and Poppler pixels proved ACI remapping, preserved TrueColor RGB, explicit 0.00 mm plus 0.35/0.70 mm lineweights, width-zero OFF output and a soft-masked 40% hatch. Native Layout.PlotTransparency and the monochrome layout persisted after DWG reopen; touched user settings were restored, the owned PID terminated and temporary DWG/PDF files were removed.
